note: Paths and quirks for the J6 Empire-to-Napoleon diff (discovery/core/*.py --games this file). Read-only inputs; extracts go under the git-ignored /extract/.

napoleon.mod_packs_note: this mod's packs that may sit in data\ (the J36 upscaler's role packs, J50): never indexed as game packs; tests/test_mod_packs.py checks every pack the upscaler config can name is listed
napoleon.pack_order_note: header type (0 boot, 1 release, 2 patch, 4 movie), then name; no pack lists a dependency (J7, 2026-10-29). Loose data\ files come after the packs in discovery/core/packfs.py (napoleon.files.loose_override is open)

extract_note: extract/<game>/<pack stem>/<entry path>, written by proxy/tools/pack_list.py --extract (see discovery/README.md); a later pack in pack_order wins
